title: Auto-close zombie directives — extend PROP-102 Mechanism B (PROP supersedes graph) to the operator-directive surface. 6 of 15 currently-pending directives are zombies whose linked PROP is at terminal status (PROP-095 implemented; PROP-104/105/106 phase-0 shipped; PROP-101 supersedes 20260614-002; PROP-106 supersedes 20260614-001 via different lineage). Tinker should detect and close them automatically per cycle.
context:
Operator audit 2026-06-19T11:30Z: 15 pending directives in queue. Classification:

  Full zombies (6) — linked PROP at terminal status, directive's task complete:
    DIRECTIVE-20260613-002 → PROP-095/implemented (1-to-1 linkage)
    DIRECTIVE-20260614-001 → PROP-106/phase-0-shadow-shipped (cross-lineage, PROP-106's directive_id is 20260616-002)
    DIRECTIVE-20260614-002 → PROP-101 (cross-lineage, PROP-101 shipped without explicit directive linkage)
    DIRECTIVE-20260615-001 → PROP-104/phase-0-measurement-shipped (1-to-1)
    DIRECTIVE-20260616-001 → PROP-105/now-actions-shipped-pre-approved-on-retrigger (1-to-1)
    DIRECTIVE-20260616-002 → PROP-106/phase-0-shadow-shipped (1-to-1)

  Partial zombies (4) — Phase 0 done, later phases gated/pending:
    DIRECTIVE-20260610-002 → PROP-091/phase-0-implemented-manifest-only
    DIRECTIVE-20260612-001 → PROP-092/phase-0-implemented-manifest-only
    DIRECTIVE-20260613-004 → PROP-097/approved-mech-1-implemented
    DIRECTIVE-20260614-003 → PROP-102/phase-0-implemented-phase-1-pending-7d-shadow-audit

  Genuinely pending (5) — no PROP or PROP designed-not-shipped:
    DIRECTIVE-20260531-008 (implement PROP-069), 20260608-002, 20260609-001, 20260610-001 (low), 20260613-003

The operator will hand-flip the 6 full zombies in this session — that's not the directive scope. The directive scope is the MECHANISM: tinker should auto-detect future zombies on every cycle and close them, so the queue doesn't accumulate dead weight.

Why this is the same defect as PROP-102 Mechanism B: PROP-102 already implements graph-walk auto-close for PROPs ('superseded_by_props: [PROP-X]' triggers close when PROP-X is terminal). Operator-directives have the same structural shape — `directive_id` field on the linked PROP creates the back-reference; PROP status at terminal means the directive's task is fulfilled. Same algorithm, different surface.

Operator's preceding 2026-06-18 tinker run cleared 3 verified-OBE zombies via a manual Mode 0 sweep (PROP-078, PROP-083, PROP-089). That worked but was hand-crafted. The structural fix puts the sweep on the same auto-detection footing as PROP-102's PROP graph walker — runs every cycle, no operator-cowork dependency.

Other-side check the operator already considered:
- ARGUE-AGAINST: 'PROP-102's auto-close is shadow-mode and waiting on 7d audit. Don't ship the directive variant before PROP-102's enforce mode lands.' Counter: shadow-mode for directive auto-close is also safe (write to ledger; don't actually flip until operator approves enforce). Same phased rollout. The two can ship independently and both observe their respective shadow windows.
- ARGUE-AGAINST: 'Cross-lineage zombies (where PROP-X obsoletes DIRECTIVE-Y but PROP-X was created from DIRECTIVE-Z) are hard to detect without operator judgment.' Counter: introduce a `supersedes_directives: ['DIRECTIVE-Y', ...]` field on PROPs, mirroring PROP-102's `supersedes_props`. Operator/tinker can declare cross-lineage supersession explicitly; the auto-closer treats it the same as the directive_id back-reference.
- ARGUE-AGAINST: 'Partial zombies (Phase 0 done, later phases pending) should NOT auto-close — they still have work.' Counter: agree. The auto-close rule should be 'directive's task language fulfilled' which is judgment-heavy. Safe default: only close when (a) linked PROP is at status='implemented' (single-phase) OR (b) linked PROP has explicit `closes_directives: true` field (multi-phase opt-in). Partials stay pending until operator decides.
task: Design and ship the directive auto-close mechanism mirroring PROP-102's Mechanism B for PROPs, applied to monitor/tinker/operator-directives/. Walk every status='pending' directive each tinker cycle, look up linked PROP via the existing directive_id back-reference, check PROP status against a terminal whitelist, and close the directive when the PROP indicates the directive's task is complete. Add cross-lineage support via an optional `supersedes_directives` field on PROPs. Phased rollout: shadow → enforce, same convention as PROP-102.
investigation_questions: Q1 — Reuse PROP-102 infrastructure or peer script? PROP-102's prop-auto-close.js already walks PROPs. Option A: extend it to also walk directives. Option B: peer script directive-auto-close.js with shared library. PROP-021's choice was peer-script when surfaces had different writers; PROP-066's choice was helper-script extraction when complexity was high. Recommendation: peer script (directive surface is small, ~15-30 directives at any time; extending prop-auto-close.js bloats it without clear win). Both can call a shared monitor/scripts/auto-close-lib.js if duplication emerges.

Q2 — Closure rules. Define the terminal-PROP-status whitelist for directive closure. Initial set: PROP.status === 'implemented' | 'shipped' | 'integrated'. Also accept PROP.status containing 'phase-0-implemented' / 'phase-0-shadow-shipped' / 'phase-0-measurement-shipped' ONLY IF the directive's task language was 'design and ship Phase 0' (judgment call — see Q3 for handling). Avoid auto-closing directives whose linked PROP is at 'pending', 'design-pending-operator-review', 'phase-0-shadow-pending-audit' — those still have decision work pending.

Q3 — Multi-phase / partial-progress directives. 4 of today's pending directives (20260610-002, 20260612-001, 20260613-004, 20260614-003) have PROPs at 'phase-0-implemented-manifest-only' or 'mech-1-implemented' — Phase 0 / Mech 1 done, more work pending. Should these auto-close? Recommendation: NO, unless the directive author opted in via `auto_close_when_phase_0_done: true` field. Default = require operator judgment for multi-phase closures.

Q4 — Cross-lineage supersession. 2 of today's 6 full zombies (20260614-001, 20260614-002) have linked PROPs that DON'T reference them via directive_id — PROP-106 was authored from 20260616-002 but addresses 20260614-001; PROP-101 was shipped without any directive linkage but supersedes 20260614-002's premise. Add a `supersedes_directives: ['DIRECTIVE-Y', ...]` field on PROPs. Mirror PROP-102's `supersedes_props` field shape. When PROP-X declares `supersedes_directives: ['DIRECTIVE-Y']` AND PROP-X is at terminal status, DIRECTIVE-Y auto-closes. Operator/tinker can backfill this field on the 2 cross-lineage cases retroactively.

Q5 — Shadow → enforce rollout. Mirror PROP-102 / PROP-106 conventions. Phase 0: shadow mode. Walk pending directives every cycle; if a directive would auto-close, append a 'would_close' row to monitor/tinker/directive-auto-close-ledger.jsonl with rationale; do NOT flip status. EXIT criteria: ≥7 days of shadow + zero false-positive would-closes (where the directive should have stayed pending). Phase 1: enforce. Flip directive status='completed', set completed_at, completed_by_run, prop_id_authored. Use a flag file monitor/decisions/directive-auto-close-enforce.flag (presence = enforce) per the PROP-102 / PROP-106 convention.

Q6 — Idempotence. The closure flip must be idempotent per the existing CLAUDE.md DIRECTIVE-LIFECYCLE additive-edit exception: only set status/completed_at/completed_by_run if currently null/pending. The exception already permits these fields to be added; auto-closer must respect the exception's transition rules (pending→completed is the only allowed transition).

Q7 — Notification. When auto-close fires, surface in tinker's latest summary: 'AUTO-CLOSED N directives this cycle (verified-OBE by linked PROP status)'. Lets the operator audit closures rather than have them disappear silently. Also include the directive_id + PROP linkage in the report-*.json findings array for forensic search.

Q8 — Backfill of cross-lineage. For today's 2 cross-lineage cases (20260614-001 → PROP-106; 20260614-002 → PROP-101), operator-cowork will hand-flip in this session. As part of THIS directive's design, propose how PROP-106 and PROP-101 should be retroactively annotated with `supersedes_directives` (one-line edit each) so the mechanism is self-documenting going forward. Going forward, when authoring a PROP that supersedes a non-back-referenced directive, the author adds the field at authoring time.
deliverable: A PROP-NNN proposal in monitor/tinker/proposals/ with: (1) Q1 script-shape decision (extend prop-auto-close.js or peer script); (2) Q2 terminal-PROP-status whitelist; (3) Q3 multi-phase handling with the auto_close_when_phase_0_done opt-in field; (4) Q4 cross-lineage support via supersedes_directives field; (5) Q5 shadow→enforce flag mechanics; (6) Q6 idempotence guarantees; (7) Q7 notification design; (8) Q8 backfill plan for the 2 cross-lineage cases. Phased rollout: Phase 0 = ship the walker + ledger in SHADOW; Phase 1 = flip enforce flag after observation. Propose-only; operator integrates after review.
constraints: Mirror PROP-102's shape exactly. Same flag-file convention, same ledger pattern, same shadow→enforce rollout. Single discipline for auto-close across PROPs and directives.

Default to CONSERVATIVE close rules. False-negative (directive stays pending when it should close) costs an operator audit step. False-positive (directive closes when work isn't actually done) loses visibility on real work. Lean conservative on terminal-status definition.

Honor the CLAUDE.md DIRECTIVE-LIFECYCLE additive-edit exception. Only the documented fields (status, completed_at, completed_by_run, prop_id_authored) may be written. Status transition pending→completed only.
Cross-lineage detection MUST be opt-in via supersedes_directives field on PROPs. Heuristic 'is this PROP about the same topic as that directive' is variance-generating and unsafe.

Phase 0 shadow runs concurrently with PROP-102 Phase 0 shadow. Both ledgers can be inspected together at the 7-day mark. Don't make this directive's Phase 1 ship gated on PROP-102's Phase 1 ship — they're independent shadow windows.
